column1: # Label taxonomy — source of truth for this repository's issue labels.
# Format: name <TAB> color (6 hex digits, no #) <TAB> description.
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. `scripts/sync-labels.sh` applies this file to GitHub.
# C- classifies the artifact that closes an issue, A- the affected surface(s), and S- its
# actionability. The taxonomy spans the stable crates and the algorithm/research surfaces.

column3: Behaviour or a measured result contradicts an established invariant or documented claim
A new capability, implementation, comparator, construction, probe, or benchmark
Improves an existing capability or measurement without introducing a new one
Internal quality, hygiene, migration, or metadata with no intended behaviour change
Documentation or literature work only
Closes with evidence: measurement, reproduction, qualification, or falsification
Closes with a concrete design or formalized mechanism
Closes with a recorded decision among already-framed alternatives
Umbrella over sub-issues; carries no implementation work of its own
Experiment measurement, reporting, and artifact generation
Experimental probes, simulations, and correctness/property harnesses
Comparators, benchmarks, transport projections, and performance experiments
Survey, bibliography, terminology, evidence catalog, and provenance
Cross-repository or external dependency pins and their revalidation
Threat models, adversarial guarantees, collision/soundness, and security assumptions
Repository structure, tracker, CI, release, migration, or governance
Not yet classified
Understood, unblocked, and actionable as written
Blocked by another issue or prerequisite named in the body
Deliberately deferred; the body states what would wake it up
